weakness: Email readable without MFA through a 2023 app password; no MFA on the accounting SaaS
remediation_plan: Delete the app password; block legacy sign-in; move email MFA to the authenticator app; turn on accounting SaaS MFA
milestones: 2026-09-30 changes made and retested from a new browser and the phone

weakness: Records archive and security documents have no backup independent of the laptop sync
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09c.); P03 G-040 (163.5(b)(2)(vi))
remediation_plan: Versioned backup of the archive into a separate account the laptop cannot change, 90-day versions; quarterly restore test; turn on ransomware folder protection
milestones: 2026-10-15 backup running; 2026-10-31 first restore test recorded
resources_required: Backup service about $100 a year; owner time

weakness: Password reuse; default router admin password; shared accounting password unchanged since the bookkeeper changed; no lost-phone procedure
source: P07 assessment (IA-05c. to IA-05i.); P01 R-006, R-008, R-015
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases for every account (CBP portals first); change the router admin password; change the accounting password; store recovery codes in the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-30 password manager in use and router and accounting passwords changed; 2026-12-31 sealed envelope with the attorney

weakness: No call-back rule for payment changes; no training on reporting social engineering or social mining
remediation_plan: Adopt POL-01 8.6 call-back rule and payee change log; client notice that bank details never change by email; small-business security course covering payment fraud and social mining
milestones: 2026-09-30 call-back log in use and client notice sent; 2026-11-30 course complete

weakness: Client records in consumer AI and messaging apps; no written client authorization for service providers; no vendor list; email storage region unconfirmed
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-012, G-014
remediation_plan: Vendor list with storage locations; confirm the U.S. region for the file suite; client authorization for named service providers (counsel review); AI business plan with no-training terms or no client data (P10)
milestones: 2026-10-15 vendor list and region confirmed; 2026-10-31 client authorization sent with the next invoices
resources_required: Counsel review about 2 hours; AI business plan about $300 a year if chosen

weakness: No incident reporting time or notification list, including the 72-hour CBP Security Operations Center notice
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-008, G-009
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; list of systems holding importer of record numbers; print contacts; walkthrough with the IT consultant

weakness: Bookkeeper works under the owner's identity in the accounting SaaS
remediation_plan: Named bookkeeper account with a limited role; MFA on
milestones: 2026-09-30 account created and the bookkeeper signed in with MFA

weakness: 2019 laptop holds client files and has never been wiped
remediation_plan: Turn on encryption, reset the laptop, reinstall it as the clean spare (P05), and record the wipe
